messages.author: af82fa98896529e2
messages.subject: simsem and semTools updates
parts:
Dear lavaan users,


The simsem and semTools packages have been updated on CRAN. Here are the updates from the previous version on CRAN:

 

[March 17, 2013] Latest Update: simsem, Version 0.5-3

This version is available on CRAN and KRAN. This simulation result of this version can save confidence interval computed by any methods (e.g., bootstrap or profile-likelihood). The coverage rate can be investigated by getCoverage, findCoverage, and plotCoverage functions. The confidence interval widths can be investigated by getCIwidth and plotCIwidth, which allows users to estimate sample size and percent missing for accuracy in parameter estimation. The inspect function is written to extract the information from the simulation result, such as inspect(Output, "fit") for fit indices of convergent replications. The summaryTime, summarySeed, and coef are also written to extract information from the simulation result. The empirical argument is added into the generate and createData functions to create multivariate normal data with the sample statistics equal to the model-implied means and covariance matrix from the provided parameters.

[March 9, 2013] Latest Update: simsem, Version 0.5-2

This version is available on KRAN. The major update in this function is that users can write a function that returns vectors of parameter estimates, standard errors, fit indices, and convergence status and specify it in the model argument in the sim function. See the help page of the sim function for an example. A minor bug in multiple group analysis was fixed.

[March 17, 2013] Latest Update: semTools, Version 0.3-2

This version is available in CRAN and KRAN. The wald function is added to conduct multivariate Wald test for any linear combinations of parameters. This function is equivalent to MODEL TEST feature in Mplus.

[February 15, 2013] Latest Update: semTools, Version 0.3-1

This version is available in KRAN only. The problem in the lisrel2lavaan function has been fixed.

 

Links

simsem: http://simsem.org/

semTools: https://github.com/simsem/semTools/wiki

 

Best,

Sunthud

messages.subject: Re: simsem and semTools updates
parts:

simsem and semTools are very helpful for teaching the SEM world in R for students. By the way, what is KRAN and where is it?

regards,

Jong-Hwa

messages.subject: Re: simsem and semTools updates
parts:
I am sorry for not thinking about using this word. It is simply our repository that we built in U of Kansas. simsem and semTools can be installed from our repository, which users can get the most recent update, by

install.packages("semTools", repos="http://rweb.quant.ku.edu/kran", type="source")

install.packages("simsem", repos="http://rweb.quant.ku.edu/kran", type="source")
